description: The root `workspaces.catalog` is the single source of truth for every third-party version in this monorepo: workspace packages only ever write `"catalog:"`, and `tools/check-catalog.ts` fails the build if one writes a literal range instead.

Renovate has no native understanding of Bun catalogs. Its `bun` manager reads `workspaces.packages` to discover workspace package.json files and stops there, and catalog extraction exists only for pnpm (pnpm-workspace.yaml) and Yarn (.yarnrc.yml). Without this manager Renovate would open zero dependency PRs for this repository: the catalog is invisible to it, and every workspace dependency reads `catalog:`, which is not a range it can bump.
So the catalog is extracted explicitly. The `catalog` depType is what the packageRules below match on.

packageRules.description: One PR a week for everything that is not a major. Reviewing thirty single-dependency PRs is how a repository ends up ignoring all of them.
Majors stay one per PR. A breaking change needs its own diff, its own CI run and its own revert.
Catalog bumps edit the root package.json only; the workspace packages already say `catalog:` and do not change. Labelled so that a reviewer knows the blast radius is every workspace at once.
